title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 18 日

stories.headline_en: Taiwan to Subsidize Companies Offering Shorter Workdays for Parents
stories.headline_zh: 臺灣將補助提供家長縮短工時之企業

sentences.en: Taiwan's labor ministry will pay companies that let working parents reduce their daily hours.
sentences.zh: 臺灣勞動部將補助讓在職家長縮短每日工時的企業。

sentences.en: Employers can receive up to forty-five thousand New Taiwan dollars per worker each year.
sentences.zh: 雇主每年每名員工最高可獲得新臺幣四萬五千元的補助。

sentences.en: This new plan helps fathers and mothers spend more time caring for young children.
sentences.zh: 這項新方案能幫助父母有更多時間照顧年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: Officials hope flexible schedules will encourage more families to raise kids in Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 官員希望彈性的工作時間能鼓勵更多家庭在臺灣育兒。

stories.headline_en: Google Warns Hackers Use AI Agents for Automated Cyberattacks
stories.headline_zh: Google 示警駭客利用 AI 代理發動自動化網路攻擊

sentences.en: Google's security team warned that hackers are now using smart AI agents in attacks.
sentences.zh: Google 資安團隊警告，駭客現在正利用智慧 AI 代理發動攻擊。

sentences.en: These automated tools can scan software updates and find weak spots without human help.
sentences.zh: 這些自動化工具能在沒有人工協助下掃描軟體更新並找出弱點。

sentences.en: In one case, a program wrote attack code right after a fix was released.
sentences.zh: 在一個案例中，某程式在修補程式發布後立即撰寫出攻擊程式碼。

sentences.en: Experts urge companies to update their systems quickly and strengthen online defense tools.
sentences.zh: 專家呼籲企業盡速更新系統，並強化網路防禦工具。

stories.headline_en: Global Tech Stocks Fall on US Chip Curbs and Rate Worries
stories.headline_zh: 受美國晶片禁令與升息預期影響 全球科技股走跌

sentences.en: Global stock markets dropped on Tuesday as investors worried about major technology companies.
sentences.zh: 由於投資人對大型科技公司感到擔憂，全球股市週二出現下跌。

sentences.en: New American rules will limit exports of advanced AI chips to five countries.
sentences.zh: 美國的新規定將限制向五個國家出口先進 AI 晶片。

sentences.en: At the same time, many traders expect higher interest rates in December.
sentences.zh: 與此同時，許多交易員預期十二月利率將會調升。

sentences.en: Because of these pressures, technology shares in both America and Asia faced heavy selling.
sentences.zh: 受到這些壓力影響，美國與亞洲的科技股皆面臨沉重賣壓。
